name: 15g speculative accept reject
title: One target pass checks four drafted tokens and keeps the agreeing prefix
subtitle: Prompt "My coffee is"; draft probability q and target probability p for each drafted token; accept if a uniform draw u < min(1, p / q)

steps.caption: The context so far is "My coffee is". A small draft model is about to guess ahead.
The draft model runs 4 cheap steps and proposes "too hot to drink", recording its own probability q for each guess.
The target model scores all 4 positions in one pass. For "too" the target likes it more than the draft did, since p = 0.60 is above q = 0.50, so it is accepted with probability 1.
For "hot" the draft was overconfident: p / q = 0.42 / 0.60 = 0.70. The uniform draw u = 0.35 is below 0.70, so "hot" is accepted.
For "to" the ratio is 0.30 / 0.50 = 0.60 and the draw u = 0.81 is above it, so "to" is rejected. Everything after the first rejection, here "drink", is thrown away.
At the rejected position the target samples a replacement from max(0, p - q), rescaled. Here only "and" (0.40 - 0.25) and "today" (0.20 - 0.15) have positive leftovers, giving 0.75 and 0.25.
Sum of the bars: 1 + 0.8 + 0.64 + 0.512 + 0.410 = (1 - 0.8^5) / (1 - 0.8) = 3.36 tokens per target pass, against exactly 1 without speculation.
steps.heading: With acceptance 0.8 and four drafts a round emits 3.36 tokens on average
